brand.name: The Beauty Cast
brand.tagline: We cast beauty creators. And we broadcast them.

hero.headline: Where beauty creators get found.
hero.subhead: We feature the creators worth watching, connect them with brands who pay, and show everyone else how to actually use what they buy.

items.label: For creators
items.title: Reach, then paid work.
items.text: We feature your reels across Instagram, TikTok and our own channels, always credited and tagged. When a brand budget matches what you make, we bring it to you.

items.label: For brands
items.title: Creator content that sells.
items.text: Tell us the product. We match creators, agree the rates, and deliver edited vertical video ready for your feed and your ads. Fixed price, ten working days.

items.label: For everyone
items.title: How to actually use it.
items.text: Real routines from real creators. What the product does, why it matters, and the order to apply it in. No jargon, no fifty-step routines nobody follows.

cast.heading: Creators we're backing right now
cast.note: Placeholder cards. Real creator clips replace these as permissions come in.

beauty_room.heading: Know what you're putting on your face.
beauty_room.intro: Short, honest guides on what a product does and how to use it. This is the part of the site that brings people back — and the part search engines find first.

articles.title: The order to apply your products in
articles.excerpt: Thinnest to thickest. That single rule fixes most routines, and it explains why your serum stopped working when you switched the steps around.

articles.title: Heat protectant: what it does and does not do
articles.excerpt: It raises the temperature your hair can survive. It does not make heat damage impossible, and the number on the bottle matters more than the brand.

articles.title: Why your press-ons pop off in three days
articles.excerpt: Almost always prep, not glue. Four minutes of surface work is the difference between three days and three weeks.

articles.title: Reading an ingredients list without a chemistry degree
articles.excerpt: The first five ingredients are most of the bottle. Everything after fragrance is usually under one percent.

packages.heading: Test creator content before you spend real money.
packages.intro: Most beauty brands don't need a campaign. They need proof that creator video sells the product. Start with three videos and find out.

items.name: Launch Pack
includes: Two hook variations on the best performer

packages.footnote: Creator fees included. No retainer, no lock-in.

advertise.heading: Put your brand in front of a beauty audience.
advertise.intro: Small beauty and wellness businesses can book a slot on this page and across our social channels. Limited inventory, so it never turns into a banner farm.
